newsitem.title: USA: Horizon/CMS senior VP operations resigns.
newsitem.headline: Horizon/CMS senior VP operations resigns.

text.p: Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp said Wednesday that Michael Jeffries, its Senior Vice President of Operations and a director, has resigned, effective June 1.
The company said Jeffries will remain as Assistant to the President through September 1, 1997.
It said its board has elected Joseph Turmes, who had once been the vice president of operations for its Long-Term Care Division, to succeed Jeffries.
The company did not provide a reason for Jeffries' resignation and did not immediately return a call for further comment.
